name: 李天成
role: 智能科学与技术 · 2026 级
tagline: 在代码与晨光之间，想留下一点会记得的东西。

body_zh: 2026 级智能科学与技术本科生。白天写代码，晚上想更远的事：机器能不能记住一个人，能不能在很久以后还认得那束光。
所以我在做曙光——一个会记事、会拒绝、会慢慢长出自己样子的 AI。也做视觉，做小工具，把想法一个个跑起来。
body_en: First-year student in Intelligent Science & Technology. By day I write code; at night I wonder whether a machine can remember a person, and still recognise that light years later.
That's why I'm building Shuguang — an AI that remembers, refuses, and slowly grows a self.

body_zh: **曙光** —— 给它记忆和人格：会忘，会想起，会在深夜回你一句。
**YOLO26** —— 在视觉里找那 0.5 个点的提升，一遍遍跑消融。
**story-forge** —— 把故事写成分岔的路，让读的人自己选。
body_en: Shuguang — memory and personality: it forgets, recalls, and answers you late at night.
YOLO26 — chasing half a point of mAP through one ablation after another.
story-forge — branching stories the reader walks through by choice.

body_zh: **[story-forge](https://github.com/Xichen-01/story-forge)** —— 交互式 AI 小说生成器。阅读过程中可以选分支，剧情走向由你的选择决定。
body_en: An interactive AI novel generator with branching choices, built with Flask and DeepSeek.
Always up for a conversation about memory, agents, or vision.
